thread:
sara: Quick heads-up — we have a request from Tooling Bridge to ship an adapter that plugs into LangChain + LlamaIndex + Gateway. Need to coordinate: marketplace listing, SI integration checklist, cert tests, and a joint announcement. Who can own the end-to-end onramp?
kevin: I can take integration tests and the cert checklist. Will need sample prompts, env matrix (CPU/GPU/q4/8), and a smoke harness.
liam: I'll handle Gateway compatibility (auth flows + routing policy). Need to confirm supported token-passing and header plumbing with Tooling Bridge.
nina: Happy to own marketplace listing + docs bundle. Can we get a short feature blurb + 3 screenshots from the partner?
maria: Suggest a 30m preflight with the partner + our SI lead. Agenda: deploy matrix, SSO, sample-app shipping, joint announcement timing. Propose Thu 10am PT. @partners-sme can you confirm partner availability? :calendar:
partners-sme: Partner ok for Thu 10am PT. They asked for a checklist for what we need ahead of the call.
sara: Perfect. Draft checklist below — please edit: 
```
- sample-app (langchain runner + llindex loader)
- quickstart README + env example (.env.example)
- cert tests: basic gen, chat, embedding compare (golden prompts)
- gateway compatibility: header passthrough, auth fallback, retry policy
- marketplace assets: 1 pager, screenshots, billing SKU suggestion
- legal: standard connector MSA + privacy appendix
```
kevin: I'll add the smoke harness link and tokenized prompt set. Also adding quantization matrix we need to test: q4_0/q8_0/fp16.
liam: Two notes: 1) for gateways we need to surface route tags for fallbacks, 2) add a note about pre-warming KV cache for long-context demos.
nina: For marketplace, we prefer a short 1-paragraph feature blurb + 2 bullets on compatibility, and 3 screenshots (console config, run, logs). I'll draft and ping for review.
partners-sme: Partner will provide sample app repo and 2 screenshots. Concern: SSO connector currently uses OIDC with custom claims, can we support that?
sara: We support custom OIDC claims, but need to document mapping. Add to action items.
maria: Action items: kevin -> cert checklist + smoke harness (EOD Wed), liam -> gateway compatibility matrix (Thu AM), nina -> marketplace draft (Wed EOD), sara -> schedule + agenda (sent). Partner -> sample repo + screenshots (Thu pre-call).
devops-bot: deploy-notify — created ephemeral test env ti-2224 for partner smoke test (expires in 72h). :robot_face:
kevin: Thanks — I'll queue tests against ti-2224 once partner repo is in.
sara: OK great. If anyone needs to move the call, speak up now. Otherwise I'll post calendar invite + agenda. :thumbsup:
kevin: one more — let's include a short rollback plan for the marketplace publish in case we need to revert listing. small blurb in the draft should be enough.
liam: Agreed. Also tagging eng-runtime for a quick perf note if they see padding issues in the sample app.
sara: Noted. I'll ping eng-runtime in a separate thread. Closing here — see calendar invite.
